title: Temps Perdu, Regrets Laissés ( Doublé )
description: Léa Durand est en couple avec Gaston Martin, issu d'une famille riche. Lorsque Gaston a une maladie incurable, Léa est enceinte, et apprend la véritable identité de Gaston. Pour le sauver, elle le quitte délibérément. Elle donne naissance à leur fils Arthur. Cinq ans plus tard, Arthur a un accident de voiture. Léa fait appel à Gaston. La fiancée de Gaston complote pour faire mourir l'enfant, et rejette la faute sur Gaston. Le malentendu entre Gaston et Léa s'aggrave.

title: Enceinte des Triplés du Roi Dragon (Doublé)
description: Vendue par sa famille à des prétendants violents contre de l'eau magique, Amélie, servante renarde que l'on croyait stérile, tombe enceinte de triplés après une nuit avec un inconnu qui est en réalité le Roi Dragon, Édouard. Tandis qu'il la protège de sa famille, de ses rivaux et de collègues jaloux, une attaque destinée à la tuer révèle qu'elle est la princesse perdue du Clan des Loups à Neuf Queues. Les ennemis tombent ; Édouard la fait sienne comme reine.

title: Ruling Over All I See II: Path to Dominion(DUBBED)
description: Judah Shaw transmigrates into the ancient world, married to three wealthy wives. But before he gets to enjoy life, his second wife Willa Zorath gets abducted by Lotia Sect, who aims to have Judah surrender to them. Unwilling to yield, he defeats the sect leader and saves Willa, only to then be hunted by Ian Walton. But now bound with the sect leader's power, he easily reclaims safety—and starts a rebellion for justice.

title: My Unicorn Girl
description: When she was eighteen, Sang Tian makes a wish to enter her mother's school to become part of the Chinese figure skating team. However, she did not pass the ranking test but somehow disguises as a guy and was accepted into the Ice Hockey team. Having no choice, she adopted a new identity. However, her plan was foiled by the sudden appearance of Wen Bing. Wen Bing and Sang Tian become room-mates. After one encounter, the two former "arch enemies" suddenly become good friends. The two of them decide to work together with their team mates and do their best in the championships. However, Sang Tian's secret was eventually exposed. Despite this, she still gets the chance to become a member of the first all-female Ice Hockey team. Sang Tian is finally able to become a real girl and continue chasing her dream.

title: The Missing Piece
description: After an accident leaves Shen Mo with amnesia, he mistakes Ji Mingxuan, the man who saved him, for his lover. But when Shen Mo regains his memories, the six months they spent loving each other become completely erased. Desperate to keep Shen Mo by his side, Ji Mingxuan proposes a three-year ""contract lover"" arrangement. When two people are already in love, can a contract still keep their hearts in check?

title: Rejected by My Fiancé, Wed to the Mafia Don
description: When Olivia is kidnapped, her fiancé Jace tells the kidnappers to keep her. Just as hope fades, Rafael, the new head of the Moretti crime family, rescues her, only to pull her into a far more dangerous world. Jace dismisses it as another game, but Olivia stops waiting for the man who abandoned her. As family betrayal and the truth behind the kidnapping collide, she must decide whom to trust and who she truly wants to become. This time, Olivia will choose her own future.

title: The Wingless Dragon: Rise of Queen
description: An prophecy names Naira as the one to unite every dragon clan. But disappointingly, she is born without wings or dragon breath. As an infant, Naira is abandoned by her own father. Her mother sacrifices her power to save her—only to spend the next nineteen years in prison.Now, the forgotten princess returns, carrying the bloodline of the Ancient Black Dragon—to rescue her mother, expose the betrayal, punish the guilty, and claim her throne with frost and flame.

title: Dragon Lord's Reborn Contract Bride
description: Reborn after a brutal betrayal, Elven Princess Eileen vows revenge. She rejects the elite red dragon and chooses Kael, a broken-winged black dragon despised as a useless beast. Everyone mocks her, but on their forbidden wedding night, Eileen’s divine blood awakens Kael’s sealed dragon god core. The crippled beast everyone looked down upon reveals his true identity—the Sovereign Dragon King. Now, the ultimate vengeance begins.

title: Exiled to Emperor
description: Imperial Preceptor Hadrian Hale united Astoria, but after his betrayal by Empress Celia Vale, he was stripped of his titles and exiled. Escaping with 800 loyal guards, Hale crushed her assassins with ease. As enemies attacked from all sides, Hale rallied powerful factions—Northmarch, Huns, and more—defeating the Sunblessed Isle, Sunset Empire, Dragon Empire, and Sultanate of Tutan. He dismantled the Celestial Kingdom and wiped out the Primordia Sect, building an army of millions. Despite the Empress's arrogant attempts to humiliate him, Hale marched on the capital, using his immortal powers to subdue the Imperial Guards, crush her final resistance, and exile her. In the end, he claimed the throne and united the realm.

title: Deserted on My Wedding Day, I Became Empress
description: Bound by an ancestral engagement, Claire Carter weds into the Hale Family, only to be deserted by groom Rylan Hale on their wedding day for his old flame.Three years later, upon Rylan’s return, she endures slander and abuse, until Emperor Julian Crowe saves her and brings down the Hales. Humiliated again at her birth family Carter’s birthday feast, Claire cuts them off after her imperial status comes to light. Julian metes out justice to the Carters and crowns her Empress.
